input.values: Borrowed span<const int64>; sort unique keys preserves ordering

constraints.semantics: Complete API, numeric, lifetime, threading and state conditions in docs/recipes/sequence.inversions_fenwick.md

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative payload lower bound, not peak memory feasibility; 64-bit platform costs in documentation
